PART III – LANDSPART III – LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is required for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act.

Boundaries to the following parcels of land mentioned in detail in Surveyor General’s schedule No. GM/DOM/2016/256 dated 11.11.2016 and located in the Village called Radawana in Grama Niladhari Division
No. 390 C Kithulakanda Radawana of Gangabadapattuwa minor Division of Dompe Divisional Secretary’s Division in Gampaha District of the Western Province are:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Kongahawatta – Extent: Around 0.0002 Hectare North and East: the land called Kongahawatta owned by Liyanage Addy; South: the Road and Lot B; West: Lot B, the land called Kahatagahawatta owned by S. A. Ranjith Nishantha and S. A. Nihal Gamini.
02. Lot ‘B’ – Kahatagahawatta – Extent: Around 0.0134 Hectare North: the land called Kahatagahawatta owned by S. A. Ranjith Nishantha and S. A. Nihal Gamini, the land
